creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 9, item 5 (the smaller point).

A one-line description, `---Go.---`, is not valid in a command block or in the script header, and the error says only that the token is unexpected:

```rad
command go:
    ---Go.---
    calls do_go
```

```
error[RAD10009]: Unexpected '---Go.---'
```

The shape looks like a short form of the header, and the Rad skill doc teaches it (batch 11, item 4), so agents write it. Either accept the one-line form or give a message saying the `---` delimiters go on their own lines.

Confirmed on main (3459ddf1).

Where: rts/check syntax-error interpretation, or tree-sitter-rad if the form is accepted.
title: Say that a description block needs --- on their own lines
